newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banco Omega denies will sell controlling stake.
newsitem.headline: Banco Omega denies will sell controlling stake.

text.p: Brazilian private bank Banco Omega denied it was holding talks with foreign and local financial institutions to sell a controlling stake, a bank spokeswoman said.
O Estado de Sao Paulo newspaper on Wednesday said Swiss Bank Corp and the NationsBank Corp were interested in Banco Omega. It added local bank Banco Interatlantico was also eyeing the deal.
Foreign banks have been in touch with Banco Omega to strenghten their relationship with the local bank, the spokeswoman said.
Based in Rio de Janeiro, Banco Omega is an active bank in privatizations, underwriting and capital markets.
